name: injective-devkit

scripts.build: npm run build -w @injective-devkit/core && npm run build -w @injective-devkit/exchange && npm run build -w @injective-devkit/wallet && npm run build -w @injective-devkit/react && npm run build -w @injective-devkit/ui && npm run build -w @injective-devkit/indexer && npm run build -w @injective-devkit/cli && npm run build -w @injective-devkit/testing
